description: Same vendor, amount and normalised invoice number paid more than once
Near-threshold payments by one requester to one vendor within 7 days that together exceed $5k/$25k
AP voucher posted on a weekend or university holiday
Requester's amounts fail the Benford first-digit test (MAD > 0.015, p < 0.001)
Exact multiple of $1,000 (stipend / fellowship accounts excluded)
Robust z-score of log(amount) > 4 within the vendor's history
$25k+ paid to a vendor created < 90 days before posting
Voucher immediately after a missing AP voucher number
